scope: Spambase logistic_linear only; no training, calibration, policy tuning, queue implementation or risk admission
tail_batch: Retain final 74 rows in the 128 condition; retain parent input order
key_lifecycle: Fresh independent low or high key pair for EVERY executed native call, matching the original fresh-call policy; high key cannot be reused across independently keyed calls. Parameter construction is cold per call; all arms include their own actual parameter/key/context setup. One key per invocation replaces the historical repeats=3 CLI batching, with no change to the per-key decision rule.
radii: Read all three existing deployment_lock.json values unchanged
parameters: Same parametersForRequest and evaluator as current harness; actual Q/P checked against parent outputs at every successful call
client_server: One local process simulates both roles. Client owns preprocessed original features and gathers retry rows before fresh high-precision encoding/encryption. Server evaluator takes ciphertexts, plaintext model constants, parameters and evaluation keys only.
packing: One ciphertext per feature; rows occupy slots; no rotations; same maximal slot capacity for full and partial batches at each scale
order: Shuffle 72 model/repeat/batch/chunk blocks; cycle shuffled six arm permutations for position balance. Lock complete 216-arm schedule before measurements.
budget_basis: No independent frozen DP-03 protocol or numerical budget exists. Inherit all 3 model seeds and 3 key repeats; use original 842 and one roadmap batch candidate 128 only. This bounded diagnostic budget is not a statistical power calculation.
failure_handling: Preserve every attempted call, unfavorable duration, execution failure and unexecuted scheduled work; continue independent arms within budget. No success-based stopping or replacement trials.
cost_scope: Instrumented local call path with parameter/key/context, client encoding/encryption, server weight preparation and HE operators, client decryption/decoding/gate, retry selection/materialization, actual JSON-file/subprocess overhead and measured observer overhead. Initial loading of already preprocessed parent inputs and model, initial build, audit/report writing are outside each arm.
units: One row request is operational trace, not an independent statistical sample; original batch is an execution grouping. Keys and slots do not imply IID evidence.
statistics: All observed values, means and raw totals only; no CI, significance, latency superiority or previous 600-trial risk bound. No coverage pass threshold.
next_stage: Recommend exactly one minimal queue experiment from evidence; do not execute it in this stage.
